comment: Per-chunk gzip-size ceilings in bytes, checked by scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs after `vite build`. A chunk fails the gate when it exceeds its budget by more than slopPercent. Chunk keys are name prefixes ("index" matches index-AbC123.js). Initial ceilings were set ~5% above the first measured build with CodeMirror + Milkdown in place; re-pin deliberately when a feature grows a chunk, so the diff in this file is what reviewers see. Chunks without an entry are reported but never fail. Export (PR after #4): index re-pinned 10.5 -> 11.7 KB for the export dialog and commands; the lazy export chunks (docx, markdownPdf = pdf-lib + renderer, marked) get their own ceilings so a dependency bump that bloats them is caught even though they never load at start-up.
